{{Quote|Captain Kosh is arriving momentarily, so stay sharp&mdash;there could be Rebel spies anywhere!|A sandtrooper in Mos Eisley|<ref name="Heroes in Hiding" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Kosh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] in charge of a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Kosh was tasked by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Nahdonnis Praji]] to [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|search]] for the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], who were carrying stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the newest [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Working in conjunction with Captain [[Mod Terrik]]'s [[Desert Sands]] [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtrooper]] unit and the elite [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], Kosh's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] followed the droids' trail to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], but R2-D2 and C-3PO ultimately escaped.

==Biography==
Kosh was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]<ref name="Heroes in Hiding" /> in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Kosh was the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in charge of a local [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], was [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|intercepted]] above Tatooine while in possession of the stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the newest Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Imperial forces seized the ship but found no trace of the plans. Organa was also captured, but she had hidden the plans inside her [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who, along with his [[Counterpart/Legends|counterpart]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], used an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to reach Tatooine's surface. After he was informed about the ejected escape pod, Vader surmised that the plans were hidden aboard and ordered his forces to have the escape pod located and the plans secured.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

[[File:ArtooThreepioTatooine-ANH.png|thumb|left|220px|On Tatooine, Captain Kosh led the search for the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO.]]
Vader assigned [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Nahdonnis Praji]] to supervise the search and recover the plans. While Vader's elite [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was being prepared, Praji appointed Kosh's garrisoned [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and the newly arrived [[Desert Sands]] [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtrooper]] unit under the command of Captain [[Mod Terrik]] to lead the search for the plans. After a brief landfall, however, Praji delegated the overall command of the operation to Kosh.<ref name="Tinker, Tailor">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref> The Imperial troops discerned that the two droids had been aboard the escape pod and followed their trail, discovering that a young [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], had acquired R2-D2 and C-3PO and was heading to the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to secure passage off-world.<ref name="ANH" />

The troops under Kosh's command searched Mos Eisley but found no trace of the two droids, who were deliberately hiding from them.<ref name="Heroes in Hiding" /> Kosh himself<ref name="Who's Who" /> soon arrived at the spaceport in a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] to oversee the search. As he was disembarking from the craft, flanked by two stormtroopers, the rest of the troops greeted him and snapped to attention.<ref name="Heroes in Hiding" /> Although the search for the droids continued, a delay in coordination between Kosh's garrison, the Desert Sands, and the 501st allowed R2-D2 and C-3PO to escape Tatooine<ref name="Tinker, Tailor" /> aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] captained by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. The droids and the plans were eventually delivered to the Rebel Alliance, allowing the Rebels to destroy the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] during the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Kosh had light skin.<ref name="Heroes in Hiding" />

==Equipment==
While serving as an Imperial, he wore a [[Color/Legends|gray]] stormtrooper [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] uniform.<ref name="Heroes in Hiding" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Kosh first appeared in ''[[Heroes in Hiding]]'', a [[1996]] children's pop-up book written and illustrated by [[Ken Steacy]]. In the book, he was identified as the officer in charge of the search for the missing droids.<ref name="Heroes in Hiding" /> This created a contradiction, as in [[1995]], [[Decipher]] had released its ''[[Premiere Limited]]'' set for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], which identified the officer leading the search operation as "Commander Praji."<ref name="Praji card">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Commander Praji}}</ref> Because the depiction of Kosh in ''Heroes in Hiding'' was very vague, the article ''[[The Empire's Finest: Who's Who in the Imperial Military]]''&mdash;published in [[Star Wars Insider 96|''Star Wars Insider'' 96]] in [[September]] of [[2006]]&mdash;dismissed the inconsistency as easily reconcilable.<ref name="Who's Who" /> However, the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', written by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published on [[February 5]], [[2009]], provided a resolution of the contradiction, integrating both Kosh and Praji into the storyline.<ref name="Tinker, Tailor" />
